title: draw_noc_panel doc comment still says 'Open Sans digits' — the diff fixed the sibling occurrence to Plex Mono but missed this one
evidence:
app/render/noc_overlay.odin:615-617: "// one scroll column. All numerals right-aligned in fixed columns (tabular
// Open Sans digits — no width jitter); colors from the canon ladder." — while the diff's own first hunk rewrote the file header to "the HUD font's digits ARE tabular: Plex Mono equal advances, verified", and app/render/view.odin:1344-1346 "draw_mono_c :: proc(...) { draw_text_font(v.font_mono, ...) }" with view.odin:1368 "FONT_MONO_ASSET :: \"assets/fonts/ibm_plex_mono_regular.ttf\""
detail: The panel draws via v.font_mono (IBM Plex Mono), and this diff corrected the identical 'Open Sans' claim in the file header to 'Plex Mono' but left the draw_noc_panel doc comment stale — the same fact now contradicts itself within one file.
recommended_fix: Change 'Open Sans digits' to 'Plex Mono digits' in the draw_noc_panel doc comment (noc_overlay.odin:617).

title: PR body claims 'Visible rows: 24 at 1280×720' — the shipped code and its own test pin 23
evidence: pr-body.md:26 "Ring buffer stays 256 (`NOC_LOG_CAP`). Visible rows: 24 at 1280×720 (was 37)" and pr-body.md:51 "- **24px rows / 24 visible rows**" — vs app/render/noc_overlay_test.odin:260 "testing.expect(t, visible == 23, \"23 visible rows at 1280x720 (574px / 24px rows)\")" (suite passes), computed from app/render/noc_overlay.odin "visible := i32((v.win_h - NOC_CONTENT_Y - NOC_CONTENT_BOTTOM) / NOC_ROW_H)" = (720-116-30)/24 = 23; the in-repo _pr_body_noc_readability_2.md:26 correctly says "Visible rows: 23 at 1280×720"
detail: The deliverable PR body overstates the row-density result by one row; the code, the new pinning test, and the in-repo PR-body copy all agree on 23. Integer division (574/24) cannot yield 24.
recommended_fix: Correct the two '24 visible rows' claims in the posted PR body to 23, matching the in-repo _pr_body_noc_readability_2.md and the pinned test.
